question: Add a limits[].kind term for an access path that a plan withholds (protocol-gated), for a mailbox with no IMAP, POP or SMTP access?
why: email/tuta (no IMAP, POP or SMTP on any plan) and email/zoho-mail (none on the free edition) file the removed protocols as retention-clamped, which describes a shortened retention and not a withheld access path; email/fastmail (Basic plans include no IMAP or SMTP; a trial account not verified by SMS cannot read mail over IMAP or POP), email/mailo (POP3 on subscribed accounts only) and email/yandex-360 (reported: no IMAP, SMTP or POP3 for an organization without a plan) would use it too.
